eyebrow: 这个州的延期昨天到期了
sub: 同一周新增 8 项火灾声明 —— 但那不等于新的延期。

rows.label: 已经结束的
rows.note: 华盛顿目前没有现行的 IRS 灾害减免。

rows.label: 8月3日 新来的
rows.value: EM-3650 华盛顿野火紧急状态
rows.note: 灾情自 8月1日 起,涉及 Chelan、Ferry、Okanogan、Spokane、Stevens、Yakima 及 Colville、Spokane、Yakama 三处保留地。另有 7 项 FM 消防拨款声明。

rows.label: 现在的状态
rows.value: IRS 尚未就此发布任何减免
rows.note: FEMA 宣布灾害与 IRS 延期是两件事、两个机关。没有 IRS 公告之前,截止日不变。

callout.label: 为什么值得盯,而不是忽略
callout.body: WA-2025-03 当初就是从一份紧急状态声明(EM)出来的,不是重大灾害声明。所以 EM-3650 有可能带来新的 IRS 减免 —— 但在公告出来之前,别按「已经延了」安排客户。

sub: Eight new fire declarations the same week — none of them a new postponement.

title: A new declaration is not a new postponement

rows.label: WHAT ENDED
rows.note: Washington currently carries no live IRS disaster relief.

rows.label: WHAT ARRIVED AUG 3
rows.note: Incident from Aug 1, covering Chelan, Ferry, Okanogan, Spokane, Stevens and Yakima counties plus the Colville, Spokane and Yakama reservations. Seven fire management assistance grants sit alongside it.

rows.label: WHERE THAT LEAVES YOU
rows.value: The IRS has issued nothing on it
rows.note: A FEMA declaration and an IRS postponement are separate acts by separate agencies. Until the IRS publishes, the deadlines stand.

callout.label: Why watch it rather than dismiss it
callout.body: WA-2025-03 itself came out of an emergency declaration, not a major disaster declaration — so EM-3650 could produce relief. Until it does, do not plan client work as though an extension exists.
